_metadata.description: Corporate tax rates, depreciation rules, inflation, and project discount rates (WACC) by country/state (2026). Tax rates are effective rates for industrial/energy projects. Depreciation is straight-line period in years for energy infrastructure. Inflation is forecast CPI for 2026. Discount rates are nominal pre-tax WACC estimates for utility-scale green hydrogen/ammonia projects.
_metadata.sources: OECD Tax Database 2026, KPMG Corporate Tax Table, PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, IMF World Economic Outlook Jan 2026, IRS Publication 946, EU MACRS equivalents, IRENA Renewable Power Generation Costs 2024, IEA World Energy Outlook 2025 WACC assumptions, BloombergNEF H2 LCOE model assumptions

US.name: United States
US.depreciation_method: MACRS 20-yr for utility-scale energy; ITC/PTC may apply
US.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects in the US; IRA incentives reduce perceived risk
US.notes: Federal 21% + average state ~4.7%. State tax varies widely (0% in TX/WY/NV/SD/OH to 11.5% in NJ). Use state-specific entries for accuracy. MACRS allows accelerated depreciation; 5-yr for solar PV, 7-yr for wind, 15-20yr for process equipment.
US.tax_incentives: IRA Section 45V clean hydrogen PTC up to $3/kg; ITC 30% for electrolysers; bonus depreciation 60% in 2026

DE.name: Germany
DE.depreciation_method: Straight-line (AfA); 20 years for process plant, 10 for electrolysers
DE.notes: Corporate tax 15.825% (incl. solidarity surcharge) + trade tax ~14% (municipality-dependent, avg Hebesatz ~400%). IPCEI H2 subsidies may offset.
DE.tax_incentives: IPCEI hydrogen funding; KfW green hydrogen loans; GRW regional subsidies in eastern states
DE.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low sovereign risk; strong policy support; mature project finance market

FR.name: France
FR.depreciation_method: Straight-line or declining balance; 15-20 years for industrial equipment
FR.notes: Flat 25% corporate tax. CET (contribution économique territoriale) replaces old taxe professionnelle. CVAE being phased out by 2027.
FR.tax_incentives: France 2030 plan hydrogen subsidies; tax credits for green industry (C3IV)
FR.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Stable market; France 2030 plan reduces policy risk

ES.name: Spain
ES.depreciation_method: Straight-line or declining balance; max rate 10% for chemical plant, 12% for energy
ES.notes: Standard 25%; reduced 15% for startups (first 2 years). Canary Islands IGIC 7% instead of IVA 21%. Basque Country has separate fiscal regime (~24%).
ES.tax_incentives: PERTE hydrogen programme; Andalusia green H2 valley incentives; renewable energy tax deductions
ES.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate; southern EU solar belt; improving bankability

IT.name: Italy
IT.depreciation_method: Straight-line; max coefficient 10% for chemical plant, 9% for energy infrastructure
IT.notes: IRES 24% + IRAP 3.9% (regional). ZES Mezzogiorno (south Italy) offers tax credits up to 60% for investments.
IT.tax_incentives: ZES Sud tax credit; Transizione 5.0 for green investments; PNRR hydrogen funding
IT.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate; regional disparities; ZES incentives help southern projects

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.depreciation_method: Straight-line; buildings min 50% WOZ value residual
NL.notes: 25.8% above EUR 200k profit (19% below). Innovation box 9% for qualifying IP income. SDE++ and IPCEI subsidies for H2.
NL.tax_incentives: SDE++ hydrogen subsidy; EIA energy investment allowance 45.5%; MIA environmental investment allowance
NL.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; Rotterdam hub; SDE++ de-risks revenue

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.depreciation_method: Capital allowances; 100% first-year for plant/machinery (full expensing from 2023); 6% SL for structures
GB.notes: 25% for profits >250k; 19% for <50k; marginal relief between. Full expensing is very advantageous for capex-heavy H2 projects.
GB.tax_incentives: Hydrogen business model (HBM) revenue support; Net Zero Hydrogen Fund; CCUS cluster sequencing
GB.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate; HBM strike price provides revenue certainty

SE.name: Sweden
SE.depreciation_method: 30% declining balance or 20% straight-line for machinery; buildings 2-5% straight-line
SE.notes: One of lowest corporate rates in EU. No municipal/regional surcharge. Energiskatt (energy tax) exemptions for industrial electricity.
SE.tax_incentives: Industriklivet fund; fossil-free steel initiative support; northern Sweden investment support
SE.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; cheap hydro; HYBRIT industrial demand certainty

NO.name: Norway
NO.depreciation_method: Declining balance 20% for machinery; 2-4% straight-line for buildings
NO.notes: 22% flat corporate tax. No resource rent tax for hydrogen (unlike oil/gas/hydro). Green Industry Fund.
NO.tax_incentives: Enova SF grants; Green Industry Fund; Norwegian NOx Fund for H2 vessels
NO.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; strong sovereign balance sheet; cheap hydro

DK.name: Denmark
DK.depreciation_method: Declining balance 25% for machinery; buildings 4% straight-line
DK.notes: 22% flat. Generous accelerated depreciation (25% declining balance). R&D super-deduction 108%.
DK.tax_incentives: Power-to-X tender scheme; Danish Energy Agency H2 support; Esbjerg port incentives
DK.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; strong wind resources; Power-to-X tendering

FI.name: Finland
FI.depreciation_method: Declining balance 25% for machinery; buildings 4-7% straight-line
FI.notes: 20% flat. Among lowest in EU. Industrial electricity tax at EU minimum. VAT increased to 25.5% in 2024.
FI.tax_incentives: Business Finland energy aid; IPCEI hydrogen participation; Ostrobothnia wind/H2 incentives
FI.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; stable Nordic market

PL.name: Poland
PL.depreciation_method: Straight-line or declining balance; 14% for machinery, 2.5% for buildings
PL.notes: 19% standard; 9% for small taxpayers <EUR 2M. SEZ/Polish Investment Zone tax exemptions for large projects (10-15yr income tax holiday).
PL.tax_incentives: Polish Hydrogen Strategy incentives; SEZ income tax exemptions; EU cohesion fund co-financing
PL.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Higher risk; policy uncertainty; SEZ tax holidays help

PT.name: Portugal
PT.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 8.33% for chemical plant; 5% for buildings; 12.5% for energy equipment
PT.notes: 21% IRC + 1.5% municipal surcharge + up to 9% state surcharge on high profits. Sines FTZ offers reduced rates. Madeira MIBC 5% rate.
PT.tax_incentives: EN-H2 national hydrogen strategy; Sines industrial zone incentives; RFAI tax credit for productive investment
PT.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate; Sines hub development; improving access to capital

GR.name: Greece
GR.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 10% for machinery, 4% for buildings, accelerated for green investments
GR.notes: 22% flat. Green transition investments qualify for super-deduction (200% for energy efficiency). SEZ Alexandroupolis/Thrace.
GR.tax_incentives: Development Law 4887/2022 investment incentives; RRF hydrogen funding; super-deduction for green investments
GR.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate-high; improving but still higher country risk premium

IE.name: Ireland
IE.depreciation_method: Straight-line 12.5% for plant/machinery (8 years); 4% for industrial buildings (25 years); accelerated for energy-efficient equipment
IE.notes: 15% rate (increased from 12.5% for large groups under Pillar Two). Knowledge Development Box 10% for qualifying IP. IDA incentives for strategic projects.
IE.tax_incentives: SEAI renewable energy grants; IDA Ireland greenfield incentives; RESS auction scheme
IE.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low-moderate; stable fiscal regime; IDA support

AT.name: Austria
AT.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 10-15% for industrial machinery; buildings 2.5% (40 years)
AT.notes: Reduced from 25% to 23% in 2024. Research premium 14% for qualifying R&D expenditure.
AT.tax_incentives: Umweltförderung (environmental subsidy); Hydrogen Strategy Austria; EAG Ökostromgesetz renewables support
AT.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; stable Alpine economy

BE.name: Belgium
BE.depreciation_method: Straight-line or declining balance; varies by asset class; buildings 3%, machinery 10-20%
BE.notes: 25% standard; 20% for SMEs on first EUR 100k. Investment deduction for energy-saving investments 20.5%. Notional interest deduction on equity.
BE.tax_incentives: Investment deduction for energy assets; Flemish ecology premium; Walloon PIVERT hydrogen plan
BE.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; Antwerp industrial cluster demand

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.depreciation_method: Declining balance typically 30-40% for machinery; cantonal rules vary
CH.notes: Federal 8.5% + cantonal/communal varies 3.5-11%. Effective rate 11.9-21.6% depending on canton. Zug (11.9%), Schwyz (13.8%), Zurich (19.7%).
CH.tax_incentives: Limited direct H2 incentives; cantonal tax holidays for qualifying new businesses (up to 10 years)
CH.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Very low risk; strong currency; limited H2 incentives

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.depreciation_method: Declining balance; 25% for machinery, 5% for buildings; elective straight-line
SA.notes: 20% for foreign investors; Saudi/GCC nationals pay 2.5% zakat instead. NEOM and other special zones may offer 0% CIT for 20-50 years.
SA.tax_incentives: NEOM green hydrogen hub incentives; Vision 2030 industrial licensing; Saudi Green Initiative; RHQ program 0% CIT
SA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; NEOM incentives offset sovereign risk; large-scale projects

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.depreciation_method: Straight-line per Ministerial Decision; useful life categories per asset class
AE.notes: 9% CIT introduced June 2023 (0% on first AED 375k). Free zones (ADGM, DIFC, KIZAD, Masdar) can get 0% CIT on qualifying income for 50 years.
AE.tax_incentives: Masdar/ADNOC H2 partnership; Abu Dhabi Hydrogen Alliance; free zone 0% CIT; no personal income tax
AE.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Free zone benefits; Masdar partnership reduces risk

OM.name: Oman
OM.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 33% for machinery (3yr), 15% for buildings; sector-specific schedules
OM.notes: 15% flat. SEZ Duqm offers 30-year tax holiday + exemption from customs. SFZ Salalah similar. Oman Green Hydrogen Strategy (Hydrom).
OM.tax_incentives: Hydrom green hydrogen concessions; SEZ Duqm 30yr tax holiday; OPAZ investment incentives
OM.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Hydrom concessions; SEZ Duqm tax holiday; moderate sovereign risk

QA.name: Qatar
QA.depreciation_method: Straight-line; rates per asset class in tax law
QA.notes: 10% flat CIT. Qatari/GCC nationals fully exempt. QFZ (Qatar Financial Centre) entities may get tax exemptions. No VAT yet.
QA.tax_incentives: Qatar National Vision 2030; QFZ incentives; no personal income tax; no VAT
QA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low local risk but limited H2 track record

AU.name: Australia
AU.depreciation_method: Effective life depreciation; prime cost or diminishing value; instant asset write-off for qualifying SME assets
AU.notes: 30% standard; 25% for base rate entities (<$50M turnover). Hydrogen Production Tax Incentive (HPTI) $2/kg for qualifying green/blue H2.
AU.tax_incentives: HPTI $2/kg H2 production tax credit; ARENA grants; CIF Powering Australia; accelerated depreciation for renewables
AU.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; HPTI incentive; mature project finance; moderate for green H2

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.depreciation_method: Diminishing value or straight-line; rates set by IRD per asset class
NZ.notes: 28% flat. No regional/state taxes. GIDI (Government Investment in Decarbonising Industry) fund.
NZ.tax_incentives: GIDI fund for industrial decarbonisation; no capital gains tax (except property)
NZ.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low sovereign risk; limited H2 market scale

JP.name: Japan
JP.depreciation_method: Declining balance or straight-line; useful life per MOF tables; special depreciation 30% for qualifying green assets
JP.notes: National 23.2% + local enterprise/inhabitant ~7.2%. Effective ~30.4%. Green Transformation (GX) bonds funding H2 supply chain.
JP.tax_incentives: GX transition bonds; carbon-neutral investment promotion tax; special depreciation 30% or tax credit 10% for decarbonisation equipment
JP.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Very low risk; GX bonds; strong offtake certainty from JERA/utilities

KR.name: South Korea
KR.depreciation_method: Declining balance or straight-line; per MOSF useful life tables
KR.notes: Progressive 9-24% + 10% local surcharge. Top rate 24% above KRW 300B. National hydrogen strategy among most ambitious globally.
KR.tax_incentives: Hydrogen Economy Roadmap; tax credits for hydrogen equipment investment (3-12%); K-Taxonomy green bonds
KR.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; Hydrogen Economy Roadmap; strong industrial demand

CN.name: China
CN.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 10yr for machinery/equipment; 20yr for buildings; accelerated for qualified tech
CN.notes: 25% standard; 15% for qualified high-tech enterprises. Western China development 15% rate. Hainan FTP 15%.
CN.tax_incentives: Hydrogen fuel cell vehicle subsidies; provincial green H2 pilots (Inner Mongolia, Hebei); R&D super-deduction 200%
CN.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate; state-backed projects lower financing cost; policy-driven

IN.name: India
IN.depreciation_method: Written-down value; 15% general plant, 40% for specified energy-saving devices; buildings 10%
IN.notes: 22% + 10% surcharge + 4% cess = 25.17% effective. New manufacturing (post 2019) can elect 15% + surcharge = 17.16%. National Green Hydrogen Mission.
IN.tax_incentives: SIGHT incentive scheme; PLI for electrolysers; National Green Hydrogen Mission ₹19,744 crore; SEZ tax holidays
IN.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Higher risk; SIGHT incentive helps; currency and regulatory risk

CL.name: Chile
CL.depreciation_method: Straight-line or accelerated (1/3 normal life); instant depreciation available for qualifying assets
CL.notes: 27% semi-integrated regime (most common). Green hydrogen law (Ley de Hidrógeno Verde) provides fiscal benefits. Antofagasta/Atacama solar zones.
CL.tax_incentives: Green Hydrogen Law tax credits; CORFO financing; accelerated depreciation for renewables
CL.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate-high; Green Hydrogen Law; currency risk

BR.name: Brazil
BR.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 10% for machinery (10yr), 4% for buildings (25yr); accelerated for qualifying industries
BR.notes: IRPJ 15% + 10% surcharge + CSLL 9% = 34%. Tax reform CBS/IBS replacing PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS effective 2026-2033. Ceará green H2 hub.
BR.tax_incentives: Legal Framework for Green Hydrogen (PL 2308/2023); SUDENE/SUDAM regional incentives (75% IRPJ reduction); Pecém green H2 hub
BR.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; High; high base rates; Pecém hub benefits from SUDENE incentives

MX.name: Mexico
MX.depreciation_method: Straight-line per asset category; 10% for machinery, 5% for buildings; 100% immediate deduction in certain regions
MX.notes: 30% flat. Maquiladora/IMMEX programs for export manufacturing. Northern border zone 20% ISR rate. Limited H2-specific incentives currently.
MX.tax_incentives: Limited; IMMEX export manufacturing; northern border zone 20% rate; renewables self-supply scheme
MX.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Higher; limited H2-specific policy; moderate country risk

CO.name: Colombia
CO.depreciation_method: Straight-line; useful life per DIAN; accelerated for qualifying renewable energy assets
CO.notes: 35% from 2022. Green hydrogen law (Ley 2099/2021) provides tax benefits for non-conventional energy sources. Free trade zones 20%.
CO.tax_incentives: Law 2099/2021: 50% income tax deduction for green energy investment; VAT exclusion on equipment; accelerated depreciation 5yr; carbon tax exemption
CO.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; High; Law 2099 incentives offset high base rates

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.depreciation_method: Straight-line; 20% for manufacturing equipment (5yr); 5% for buildings; Section 12B for renewables
ZA.notes: 27% flat (reduced from 28% in 2023). Section 12B allows 100% first-year deduction for qualifying renewable energy assets. SEZ programme 15% rate.
ZA.tax_incentives: Section 12B 100% first-year renewable deduction; SEZ 15% reduced rate; Section 12BA accelerated depreciation; Green Hydrogen Commercialisation Strategy
ZA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; High; Eskom grid uncertainty; Section 12B helps but currency risk

MA.name: Morocco
MA.depreciation_method: Straight-line or declining balance; 10-15% for machinery; 4-5% for buildings
MA.notes: Progressive 10-35% but 20% standard for most companies. Export-focused CFC zones: 0% first 5 years then 8.75%. Noor-Ouarzazate solar complex. Green hydrogen roadmap.
MA.tax_incentives: CFC Tangier/Kenitra zones; Offer Maroc green H2 strategy; MASEN renewable energy development; Hassan II Fund
MA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate-high; EU proximity for export; CFC zone benefits

EG.name: Egypt
EG.depreciation_method: Straight-line; rates set by Ministry of Finance per asset class
EG.notes: 22.5% standard. SCZONE (Suez Canal Economic Zone) offers tax holidays up to 10 years + customs exemptions. High inflation is major risk factor.
EG.tax_incentives: SCZONE tax holidays; Green Hydrogen Strategy; Investment Law incentives (Golden License); MoU with EU for renewable H2
EG.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; High; high inflation premium; SCZONE incentives help

NA.name: Namibia
NA.depreciation_method: Straight-line; manufacturing assets over 3 years; buildings 2.5%
NA.notes: 32% standard. Export processing zone (EPZ) entities: 0% corporate tax. Registered manufacturer: reduced rates. Tsau //Khaeb green H2 hub.
NA.tax_incentives: EPZ 0% CIT for export processing; Tsau //Khaeb (Lüderitz) green H2 special incentives; Special Economic Zones Act
NA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; High; frontier market; Tsau//Khaeb mega-project de-risks somewhat

KE.name: Kenya
KE.depreciation_method: Capital deduction allowances; 100% first year for machinery in certain sectors; buildings 10% IBD
KE.notes: 30% standard. SEZ enterprises 10% for first 10 years, then 15%. EPZ companies: 0% for 10 years then 25%.
KE.tax_incentives: SEZ 10% rate; EPZ tax holiday; Kenya Green Economy Strategy
KE.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Very high; limited infrastructure; frontier market premium

SG.name: Singapore
SG.depreciation_method: Section 19/19A capital allowances; 1-year write-off or 3-year SL for qualifying assets
SG.notes: 17% headline but effective can be lower with partial exemptions. Pioneer/Development & Expansion incentives (5-15% for qualifying activities). Low-carbon hydrogen is strategic priority.
SG.tax_incentives: Pioneer Certificate 5% or 0% tax; Development & Expansion Incentive; EDB project grants; SG Green Plan 2030
SG.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low risk; stable AAA-rated; Pioneer tax incentives

CA.name: Canada
CA.depreciation_method: CCA declining balance; Class 43.1/43.2 for clean energy (30-50%); Accelerated Investment Incentive first-year enhanced
CA.notes: Federal 15% + provincial 8-16% (avg 11.5%). Alberta 8%, Ontario 11.5%, Quebec 11.5%, BC 12%. Clean hydrogen ITC 15-40% depending on CI.
CA.tax_incentives: Clean Hydrogen ITC 15-40% based on carbon intensity; Clean Technology ITC 30%; Class 43.2 accelerated CCA; Atlantic Investment Tax Credit
CA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Low; Clean Hydrogen ITC; strong project finance market

US_TX.name: US - Texas
US_TX.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; no state income tax; franchise tax (margin tax) on gross receipts
US_TX.notes: No state income tax. Texas franchise (margin) tax 0.75% on taxable margin (retail/wholesale 0.375%). Property tax avg 1.65% (varies by county). Ch. 313 tax abatement expired; Ch. 403 TELA may replace. Sales tax 6.25% state + up to 2% local.
US_TX.tax_incentives: IRA Section 45V PTC; no state income tax advantage; Texas Enterprise Fund; property tax abatements via local agreements
US_TX.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; No state income tax; strong H2 infrastructure; Gulf Coast hub

US_CA.name: US - California
US_CA.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; California does not conform to federal bonus depreciation
US_CA.notes: State tax 8.84% (min $800). Does NOT conform to federal bonus depreciation or 100% expensing. Sales tax 7.25% state + up to 3.5% local. Property tax ~0.74% (Prop 13). Cap-and-trade carbon market adds cost for emitters but benefits H2.
US_CA.tax_incentives: LCFS hydrogen credits; CalSTA ARCHES H2 hub; CARB ZEV mandates; IRA stacking with LCFS
US_CA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Higher costs offset by LCFS credits; mature renewables market

US_LA.name: US - Louisiana
US_LA.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; Louisiana conforms to federal depreciation
US_LA.notes: State corporate 3.5% flat (reduced from progressive in 2025). Franchise tax $1.50/1000 of capital. Sales tax 4.45% state + local. ITEP (Industrial Tax Exemption) for property tax on manufacturing.
US_LA.tax_incentives: ITEP 80% property tax exemption for 10yr; Quality Jobs Program; H2 hub (HALO) federal/state support; IRA PTC/ITC stacking
US_LA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; ITEP property tax exemption; H2 hub (HALO) support

US_NY.name: US - New York
US_NY.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; NY does not conform to federal bonus depreciation (must add back)
US_NY.notes: Business corporation franchise tax 7.25% (temporary surcharge). 0.15% MTA surcharge in NYC metro. Does NOT conform to federal bonus depreciation. NYC adds 8.85% city corporate tax. Property tax high ~1.7%.
US_NY.tax_incentives: Excelsior Jobs Tax Credit; Green CHIPS Act; NY-Sun; Offshore Wind incentives
US_NY.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Higher cost environment; offshore wind H2 potential

US_OH.name: US - Ohio
US_OH.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; no state corporate income tax; CAT gross receipts tax
US_OH.notes: No state corporate income tax. Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) 0.26% on gross receipts >$1M (being phased down). Sales tax 5.75% state + up to 2.25% county.
US_OH.tax_incentives: Ohio Job Creation Tax Credit; H2 hub participation; property tax exemptions for energy projects
US_OH.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; No state CIT; Midwest H2 hub participation

US_WY.name: US - Wyoming
US_WY.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; no state income tax
US_WY.notes: No state corporate or personal income tax. Sales tax 4% state + up to 2% local. Very low property tax. Most business-friendly tax climate in US.
US_WY.tax_incentives: IRA PTC/ITC; WY ENDOW grants; Industrial Siting Council permits for large energy projects
US_WY.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Most business-friendly; no state income tax

US_NV.name: US - Nevada
US_NV.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; no state income tax; Commerce Tax 0.051% on gross revenue >$4M
US_NV.notes: No state corporate/personal income tax. Commerce Tax 0.051% on gross revenue. Modified business tax on payroll. Sales tax 6.85% state+local. GOED abatements available.
US_NV.tax_incentives: GOED tax abatement program; Tesla/battery corridor incentives; IRA PTC/ITC
US_NV.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; No state CIT; GOED abatements; solar-rich

US_WA.name: US - Washington
US_WA.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; no state income tax; B&O gross receipts tax
US_WA.notes: No state corporate/personal income tax. B&O tax 0.484% (manufacturing) on gross receipts. Sales tax 6.5% state + local. Climate Commitment Act cap-and-trade.
US_WA.tax_incentives: Clean Energy Fund; B&O tax credits for manufacturing; Pacific Northwest Hydrogen Hub participation
US_WA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; No state CIT; cheap hydro; Pacific NW H2 hub

US_NM.name: US - New Mexico
US_NM.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; NM conforms to federal depreciation schedules
US_NM.notes: Corporate 5.9% flat. Gross receipts tax (GRT) 5.125% state + local (replaces sales tax). JTIP job training incentive. LEDA closing fund.
US_NM.tax_incentives: JTIP job training; LEDA (Local Economic Development Act); renewable energy production tax credit; IRA stacking
US_NM.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Moderate; good solar/wind; JTIP incentives

US_FL.name: US - Florida
US_FL.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; Florida conforms to federal IRC with modifications
US_FL.notes: State 5.5% (first $50k exempt). No personal income tax. Sales tax 6% + up to 2.5% local. QTI (Qualified Target Industry) tax refund program.
US_FL.tax_incentives: QTI tax refund; Enterprise Zone incentives; Capital Investment Tax Credit; no personal income tax
US_FL.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; No personal income tax; QTI refund programme

US_IL.name: US - Illinois
US_IL.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; Illinois does not allow federal bonus depreciation (must add back); uses own 10% depreciation addition modification
US_IL.notes: CIT 7% + PIF replacement tax 2.5% = 9.5%. Among highest combined state+local taxes. Property tax very high ~2.1%. Does NOT conform to federal bonus depreciation. EDGE tax credits for job creation.
US_IL.tax_incentives: EDGE (Economic Development for a Growing Economy) tax credit; Enterprise Zone incentives; Midwest H2 hub participation; REV Illinois Act
US_IL.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Higher combined tax; Midwest H2 hub; REV Illinois Act

US_PA.name: US - Pennsylvania
US_PA.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; PA is phasing down CNI rate; does not fully conform to federal bonus depreciation
US_PA.notes: CNI rate 7.99% (being phased to 4.99% by 2031). Sales tax 6% + 2% Philadelphia. Keystone Opportunity Zones offer tax-free status.
US_PA.tax_incentives: Keystone Opportunity Zone 0% state tax; MACH2 H2 hub; PA EDGE tax credit
US_PA.discount_rate_note: Nominal pre-tax WACC for green H2 projects; Keystone Opportunity Zones; MACH2 H2 hub; CNI rate declining

US_AZ.name: US - Arizona
US_AZ.depreciation_method: Federal MACRS; Arizona fully conforms to federal bonus depreciation and TCJA provisions
US_AZ.notes: State 4.9% flat. Transaction privilege tax (sales) 5.6% state + local. Low property tax. Full bonus depreciation conformity. GPEC incentives.
US_AZ.tax_incentives: GPEC (Greater Phoenix Economic Council) incentives; AZ Commerce Authority QFIE credit; federal IRA PTC/ITC
